habillage: indexed palette with quantised shade tables and a 6-step haze towards a very pale blue (#DCEEF5), rendered at 270x480 and scaled x4 nearest-neighbour
Jersey 15 cartouches on cream with ink border (hook, dates, narrative; one at a time since the A+B+C pass; Jersey 20 reserved), Jersey 10 mentions only; never text on the map or sky
mecanique: 3D depth is the rule: perspective ground (Mode 7 style) at any pitch, terraced heightfield with lit / shaded risers, cast shadows, layered depth and a camera that keeps moving forward (one single camera per short)
cut-away section of the ground (ink base, coloured walls) as the on-ground diagram
dive / climb-back camera move in true perspective as the signature transition
autres: form, not content: a pixel-art look for explainers, kids, history and narrated shorts, not a video-game or flight theme (no score, no game element; HUD and cockpit optional and absent from the proofs)
no phosphor plate (pixel-arcade) and no "ALT ... M" readout (topo-relief)
